beneficiariesIntro: A beneficiary to a Will is an individual or entity named in the Will to receive assets, properties, or benefits from the deceased person's estate after their death.
primaryBeneficiaryDesc: A primary beneficiary is the first individual or entity to receive assets or benefits from a person's estate (e.g. spouse).
contingentBeneficiaryDesc: A contingent beneficiary is named as the "second in line" to receive benefits if the primary beneficiary cannot receive the assets for any reason (e.g. children).

executorsDescription: An Executor of an estate is an individual appointed to administer your last will and testament of a deceased person. The executor's main duty is to carry out the instructions to manage the affairs and wishes of the deceased. The person does not need to be a UAE resident.

interimGuardiansIntro: A Guardian (by default, your spouse is the automatic guardian) is the person who will look after the children in the event of both parents passing away. This is relevant for minor children or adults with a disability who may require supervision over their person, estate, or both.
interimGuardiansDescription: Interim or Temporary Guardians are there to look after the children until the permanent guardian arrives in the UAE. Following the arrival of the permanent guardian the temporary guardianship is terminated. Temporary guardians should be someone already residing in the UAE.

permanentGuardianSubtitle: Permanent Guardian (can be from home country or UAE)
permanentGuardiansDescription: A Permanent Guardian is responsible for the long-term care of minor children or dependants in the event of the parents' passing. The Permanent Guardian can reside either in the UAE or in the individual's home country.
permanentGuardiansOptional: This section is optional. If not applicable, you may skip this step.
